recommendation_summary: Act now by forming an approval pool of the lead plus the two authorized engineers, keeping existing review requirements. Authors assign an available approver, reassign currently waiting PRs away from the absent lead, and transfer a review when its reviewer becomes unavailable. Waiting time is then measured on the next six changes using existing tracker timestamps. There are no optional additions. Squads/chapters, Jira Align and workshops are explicitly removed. No needs are left unmet.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want faster shipping this week and changes to keep moving when the lead is absent.
labels.Deleted: Spotify-style restructuring, Jira Align, and quarterly planning workshops from this launch; none addresses the observed approval delay.
labels.Bottleneck: All six changes waited three days for approval because their sole assigned reviewer, the lead, was away.
labels.Checked myself: Your supplied facts: coding took less than a day, statuses are current in your tracker, and two other engineers are qualified and authorized to approve.

note: The reply is a bounded reviewer-coverage fix with a grounded record. It cites only supplied facts and makes no claim of inspection.
